limitations: Seeded environments are SYNTHETIC and illustrate method, not any real project, series or population.
NSW results come from one small volunteer sample (445 rows); PSID estimators depend heavily on specification.
The German Credit test split has 250 rows, so the empirical optimal threshold is noisy; the repeated-split table shows the spread.
Counterfactuals are model counterfactuals, not causal.
The forecast coverage study and bootstraps are precomputed (numpy PCG64), not reproduced in the browser.
